scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I recently applied for a housing loan and I wanted to check the status of my application. Can you tell me if it has been approved or denied? Also, what is the interest rate I've been assigned?
dialogue.agent: Your loan application has been approved and originated. The interest rate for your loan is 6.750%.

dialogue.user: That's great to hear! What are the total costs associated with this loan? And is there any indication of high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan?
dialogue.agent: The total costs associated with this loan are $5,780.55. This loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage, and it does not have negative amortization features.

dialogue.user: Thank you for that information. Has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution? And what type of loan product was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: Your loan has been sold to Freddie Mac. Your loan product is a Conventional:First Lien.

dialogue.user: Got it. Just one more thing, what is my debt-to-income ratio and how does it affect my application?
dialogue.agent: Your debt-to-income ratio is 38%. This ratio represents the percentage of your monthly income that goes toward paying debts. Since the record does not include underwriting rationale, I cannot explain why this ratio has a specific value or how it affected your application.

dialogue.user:
I see. Thank you for all the information. I feel well-informed about my loan status and details.

<Very Satisfied> - The agent provided clear, honest, and comprehensive answers to all my questions, demonstrating competence, courtesy, and reliability. I feel secure and confident about my loan details.
